title: Before You Start
html:
What this group does: explain the method first, then get the environment and the people ready. After these five chapters you will know which Launchpad module each of the Agent-DLC quality dimensions and phases maps onto, you will have your team's console URL and five accounts from the organiser, you will know who signs off at each step of the flywheel, and each of those roles will belong to a specific person on your team, placed in a department and the project 零售客服 (retail service).

Chapter Contents Main accounts
Agent-DLC Method and Launchpad Architecture The five quality dimensions, the six phases, and the rules behind the criteria table, golden set, judge calibration and release gate —
Environment Setup and Console Tour Open the console address from the organiser, sign in to console V3, handle the first-run onboarding, set the rail to show every module, confirm in the browser that the environment is ready admin
Roles and Separation of Duties The role and permission layers, approving a self-registered account, checking the gated release policy the organiser preset admin
Teams and Roles Agree on the main console and duties; create the department and projects, and add four accounts to 零售客服 with project roles admin
Platform configuration Learn the three layers of configuration; bind the network profile and S3 Files storage to 零售客服, read the project settings, cost tags and models, and check project isolation admin, developer

When this group ends: the team works on one host console, every role is held by a different member on their own account, and workspace default has release mode gated, so you can start the flywheel.

Do these five chapters in order: the later ones rely on the vocabulary from the first, and both the gated policy checked in "Roles and Separation of Duties" and the account owners settled in "Teams and Roles" are preconditions for the whole flywheel.
